capabilities: Render segerlab-calculation code blocks as interactive calculator views
Copy calculator state from the Segerlab app via an Obsidian button
Display a Stull chart panel of calculator points found in the opened note
Configure a search query template to find notes containing calculators
Toggle display of extended calculated coefficients
extras: Not yet available in the Community Plugins store; manual installation from releases is required. A Russian README (README.ru.md) is referenced, and the interface adapts to English or Russian Obsidian language settings.
problem: Obsidian has no way to display glaze calculation calculators, so potters cannot view or work with Segerlab calculator data inside their notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin brings calculators views from Segerlab app into your Obsidian notes.

summary: Renders interactive glaze calculator views in notes from JSON code blocks copied from the Segerlab app for ceramists.
